新增大型藥水瓶附魔：無限續杯讓飲用後瓶內份數不減少；容量擴充 I～V 每級增加一份，最多八份。蹲下對鍋使用可補充藥液；正常使用倒出，倒出仍扣除實際轉移量。裝填與倒出保留附魔、名稱及藥液資料。

Large Potion Flasks now accept Bottomless and Capacity I–V. Bottomless drinking preserves doses while applying effects; pouring still consumes the transferred amount. Capacity adds one dose per level, from three to eight. Sneak-use a cauldron to top up compatible mixtures.

Minecraft 26.2 / Fabric / Java 25. Requires Fabric API and TotemCore >=0.7.18 <0.8.0.
